race.comment: THE CUNNING FOX (1) has yet to be beaten over 3200m, although some of those wins have been over hurdles. He has shown in his last couple of starts that he still retains plenty of pace on the flat, and with a drop in class from his last run at Geelong, he is the one to beat in this. DEVOTED TO YOU (7) broke through for an overdue maiden win when scoring by almost a length at Ballarat over 2648m last time out. She will relish getting out to 3200m, and now that the penny has dropped, she can repeat the dose. TEMPEST MOON (3) is up in trip, and she will find this easier than her last start. Keep safe. ROARING ENGINE (2) has a good draw, and is right in this.
